metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: This mockumentary about vampire roommates blends dry comedy and surreal ensemble dynamics, matching the vibe of Community and It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Its heartwarming tone, quirky ensemble of characters, and sharp workplace wit make it the perfect comforting watch for fans of Ted Lasso and New Girl.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: An easy-watching, fast-paced ensemble comedy with a heart, ideal for fans of Scrubs and the clever comedy of The Good Place.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A beloved British sitcom featuring eccentric, socially awkward characters that will appeal to fans of Peep Show and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: This cult British comedy is packed with pop-culture references and surreal humor, appealing directly to fans of Community and PhoneShop.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: A highly-rated, witty adult animation filled with rapid-fire dialogue and high-concept sci-fi and action elements, ideal for fans of Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A wholesome, funny, and incredibly comforting animated family sitcom that perfectly matches the energy of King of the Hill and The Simpsons.

metas.name: The Office
metas.description: A masterclass in comfort television and background viewing, sharing its dry, mockumentary humor with shows like Arrested Development.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: A fast-paced, highly cynical comedy featuring brilliant, rapid-fire insults that will appeal to fans of Silicon Valley and Arrested Development.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: An underrated gem about a cynical catering crew that captures the deadpan, slightly dark comedic energy of Silicon Valley and It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A heartwarming, high-concept riches-to-rags comedy that offers the ultimate comfort and feel-good growth, reminiscent of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A fast-paced, hilariously chaotic comedy set in Northern Ireland that delivers the raw, witty charm found in Brassic.

metas.name: Bored to Death
metas.description: This quirky, lighthearted mystery-comedy about an amateur detective is a great fit if you enjoyed Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: An incredibly charming, dry-witted musical comedy that aligns perfectly with the offbeat, low-key humor of Peep Show.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: An energetic, chaotic buddy comedy about two friends in New York, sharing the hilarious, boundary-pushing energy of It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Workaholics
metas.description: A laid-back, stoner-adjacent workplace comedy that matches the lazy, chaotic energy of PhoneShop and Top Buzzer.

metas.name: Nathan for You
metas.description: If you enjoy cringe humor and social awkwardness in Peep Show, this brilliant, deadpan reality-comedy series is a must-watch.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description: A classic British comedy focusing on awkward teenage dynamics and crude, highly quotable humor, appealing to fans of PhoneShop.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by the mastermind behind Scrubs, this fast-paced, hanging-out sitcom offers the same comfort and running jokes as New Girl.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: Co-created by the minds behind Ted Lasso, this hilarious and heartwarming comedy-drama strikes the perfect balance of laughter and emotion.

metas.name: Search Party
metas.description: A satirical mystery-comedy that perfectly blends suspense with dark humor, matching the tone of Dirk Gently and The Chair Company.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A highly-rated animated action-comedy with brilliant world-building and hilarious parody elements, perfect for fans of Rick and Morty and Futurama.

metas.name: Harley Quinn
metas.description: An action-packed, profane, and hilarious animated series that subverts the superhero genre, fitting right in with One-Punch Man.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A warm, lighthearted, and incredibly fun pirate adventure comedy that matches the swashbuckling joy of ONE PIECE.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: The ultimate British comfort-reality show where comedians complete ridiculous tasks, perfect for a relaxing background watch like Gogglebox.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: An incredibly reliable and hilarious family mockumentary that serves as the perfect low-stress, comforting background show.

metas.name: Catastrophe
metas.description: A sharp, witty, and honest British-American comedy-drama that captures the grounded, clever humor of Master of None.

metas.name: Green Wing
metas.description: A surreal and bizarre British hospital sitcom that leans heavily into physical and absurd humor, ideal for fans of Scrubs.

metas.name: Fresh Meat
metas.description: From the creators of Peep Show, this university-set comedy offers a brilliant blend of awkward situations and lovable but flawed characters.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A highly clever, fast-paced corporate satire with a heart, ideal for fans of Arrested Development and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: A highly comforting, hilarious workplace sitcom with a great ensemble cast, perfect for fans of New Girl and Community.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: A fresh, hilarious British comedy set in a world where everyone gets a superpower except the protagonist, matching the charm of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Plebs
metas.description: A hilarious British sitcom following three young men trying to survive in Ancient Rome, sharing the comedic DNA of PhoneShop.

metas.name: The Mighty Boosh
metas.description: An wonderfully absurd and surreal British comedy that will appeal to fans of Dirk Gently and the oddball humor of Community.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: A hilarious, fast-paced animated sci-fi comedy that lovingly pokes fun at genre tropes, perfect for fans of Futurama.

metas.name: Detroiters
metas.description: A joyful, hilariously warm buddy comedy about two ad-men in Detroit, sharing the wholesomeness of Ted Lasso with the absurdity of Sunny.

metas.name: Happy Endings
metas.description: A fast-paced, joke-a-minute sitcom about a tight-knit friend group, sharing the incredible comedic energy of New Girl and Community.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, this anime brilliantly blends spectacular comedic action with a wholesome, emotional core.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A lighthearted, warm, and highly comforting family sitcom that is incredibly easy to watch in the background.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A heartwarming, witty mockumentary sitcom that provides fantastic, wholesome laughs in the style of Parks and Recreation.
